sections.title: iOS Setup (iPhone & iPad)
instructions: 1. Scan the QR code above to open the portal.
2. Open in Safari (Required — Safari is the only browser on iOS that supports full-screen standalone PWA mode without address bars).
3. Tap the Share button ( ↑ ) and select 'Add to Home Screen'.
4. Launch Iris from your home screen and enter your Panel Password to pair.

sections.title: Android Setup
instructions: • Preferred: Native Android App — Best performance, keep-screen-on support, and auto-reconnect.
• Alternative: Chrome PWA — Open in Chrome, tap menu ( ⋮ ) → 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'.

controls.label: Native Companion App
controls.description: Download and install the native Android Iris.apk directly on your phone.

sections.title: Connection & DHCP Tips
instructions: • Live Dynamic QR: The QR code above automatically updates whenever your PC's local IP address changes.
• If Connection Drops: If your router assigns a new IP address, simply scan the QR code again — your device reconnects immediately at the new address without losing paired status.
• Set & Forget: For the most reliable connection, reserve this PC's local IP in your router's DHCP reservation settings.
• Security Notice: Iris runs on your local Wi-Fi over HTTP. Browser 'connection not secure' notices are normal for local network devices.
